about: World camera. mode 'iso' is the tilted Diablo-style view: the ground is turned yawDeg and seen from pitchDeg above the horizon (ground squash = sin(pitch)), the hero stays at heroScreenY of the screen height, and walls, trees and houses get height. Add ?flat=1 to the address to get the old top-down view. Changing pitchDeg also re-bakes the 3D models at bakePitchDeg (defaults to pitchDeg). Heights are in tiles before the pitch is applied; heightScale multiplies all of them. groundTexel is the pixels per tile of the cached ground picture (higher is sharper and uses more memory). crowd.inactiveFull: during big pulls only this many inactive (far, frozen) monsters nearest the hero are drawn as full 3D models; the rest are drawn as cheap shaded blobs (-1 = draw all). pretiltGround draws the floor from a picture already tilted at pretiltTexel pixels per tile (a straight copy each frame); false rotates the flat floor every frame.
